title: [finding] The #13179 root-extension revival condition FIRES: same-audience tracker-id prose outside packages/spec/src measures ~11 candidate sites, past the codified threshold
body:
Filed by the #13156/#13179 family os-dev seat (session `session_01KX8wnyjStaZcuMyAMNsy3N`, branch `claude/issue-13156-fifth-population`) as the instrument card the #13179 adjudication prescribed. Unassigned — recording, not claiming; grading is triage's.

**Dedupe declaration:** repo-scoped REST reads answer in this container, but the search API is not repo-scoped and answers 403, so the mandatory duplicate check ran as one MCP semantic search. Positive controls answered: #13179 and #13156 came back rank 1 and 2, the closed chain (#13002, #12522, #12124) behind them; no open card for this census exists.

## The codified condition, and the measurement that trips it

The 2026-08-29 Class-1 adjudication on #13179 deferred extending `check-doc-authoring` Rule 3's scanned root beyond `packages/spec/src`, with the revival condition codified verbatim: 「何时重议:任何后续 census 显示跨包人口 ≥ 一位数,立卡送分诊」 (the 13:50 leg: 「任何后续 sweep 在 spec 外再见 ≥3 条同受众 id 即回炉为仪器卡」). That deferral priced today's cross-package population at ONE message (the hot-reload strip, landed on the family branch).

The family PR's diff-derived twin sweep plus a targeted source sweep (non-test `*.ts` under `packages/`, excluding `packages/spec`, string literals only — comments, route-ledger `note:` records and ops-only log lines excluded) reads **about 11 candidate sites** of same-audience refusal / warn / lint prose carrying tracker ids:

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:1036` — registration-time warn, ignored legacy apiMethods
- `packages/objectql/src/having-filter.ts:186` — refusal, unfiltered-aggregates clause
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:3544` — parent-reference refusal
- `packages/metadata/src/endpoint-matcher.ts:211` — endpoint publish-gate exclusion prose
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/comparand-shape.ts:598` — between-endpoint refusal
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/filter-normalizer.ts:924` — filter refusal citing a ruling id
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:1341` — connector-instance notice
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:10966` — engine-capability refusal (cross-repo id spelling)
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:19879` — org-scope refusal prescription citing two ids
- `packages/lint/src/validate-react-page-props.ts:434` — lint message citing a ruling id
- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:1360` — lint message citing a split id

Two of these already have deliberate test twins pinning the id-bearing text (`objectql/src/registry.test.ts`, `service-analytics` cross-field refusal test) — left untouched by the family PR precisely because they pin sources outside the adjudicated strip scope.

## Confidence gaps (must-read before grading)

1. **Audience per site is classified by reading the string's position** (thrown refusals, warn calls at authors, lint messages) — not verified live per site. The ops-log/author-notice boundary needs triage's judgment (e.g. `runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:1362`, a logger.warn, was excluded as ops-facing).
2. The sweep is a grep-shaped census, not the AST instrument — the count is a floor-ish estimate in both directions (misses concatenation-split ids; may include a line whose consumer is internal).
3. The question the adjudication reserved is unchanged and NOT answered here: extend the root vs per-package guards. This card carries the number that reopens it, nothing more.

Evidence of record: the family PR on #13156/#13179 (its report carries the sweep commands), and the #13179 adjudication comment of 2026-08-29 14:55 where the condition is codified.
